description: Precision-gate controls for the bounded char/word TF-IDF candidate retriever. This development-only fixture adds no independent or production-accuracy claim.
provenance: Controls are derived from the separately authored semantic-development fixture and deliberately tuned against the reviewable catalog. They are regression tests, not holdout evidence. The cold-build ceiling is sized for the V13 catalog while warm-query, memory, and admission precision gates remain unchanged.
